name: Restoran 010 — Kasa karosu açılır
description: Demo Restoran (010) Restoran kabuğunda mali gün açıldıktan sonra Kasa karosu kasa/modül ekranını açar.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the RetailEX login page
Connect tenant retailex_demo if needed, then sign in as admin / admin
Select firm Demo Restoran or Firma 010, pick a store if needed, and enter the app
Open the top shell module labeled Restoran
If Günü başlat is visible, click it and complete the register/opening-cash modal to activate the day
Click the dashboard tile labeled Kasa after it is enabled (not grayed out)
Verify a Kasa cash module screen titled Kasa ve finans or cash list/operations is visible within the Restoran shell
